instruction: Merge `/home/user/Desktop/partA.sch` and `/home/user/Desktop/partB.sch` into a single-sheet schematic and save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/merged.sch`. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/merged.sch` must parse as well-formed XML. 2. It must contain exactly 4 `<part>` entries. 3. All 4 refdes must be unique. 4. The parts from `/home/user/Desktop/partA.sch` must remain present as `R1` with value `10k` and `R2` with value `4.7k`. 5. The merged schematic must also contain one part with value `1k` and one part with value `100n`. 6. The `R1` coming from `/home/user/Desktop/partB.sch` must end up with a refdes other than `R1`. [Software] On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).
